WalMark.doc: Cut-point identifying the boundary between pre-savepoint and post-savepoint changes. Under WAL backend this is the mx_frame value at push time; under rollback-mode journal backend it is the journal byte offset at push time. Targets pick the appropriate runtime mapping per backend; the abstract type is just an opaque marker.

SavepointFrame.doc: One frame on the savepoint stack. Captures the cut-points needed to revert all storage state (page deltas + schema deltas) back to push time. The frame does NOT copy page images — revert reads pre-savepoint page images out of the WAL or rollback journal.

SavepointStore.doc: The savepoint stack. LIFO: deepest frame at index 0, innermost at the top. `implicit_outer_open` is true iff the storage layer silently began the outer transaction during the FIRST push (no caller-issued BEGIN was active at that moment). Cleared on the matching outermost RELEASE that empties the stack (pin S4). Resets to empty on crash recovery (pin S9).

SAVEPOINT_STACK_MAX_DEPTH.doc: Hard cap on simultaneous open savepoints. Push beyond this raises SavepointStackOverflow. v1 picks 32; revisit only if a real workload demonstrates need.

push_savepoint.doc: Push a new frame named `name` onto the stack. Captures wal_mark, schema_mark, and page_dirty_set_mark from `pager`. If no transaction is open, silently begins one and sets implicit_outer_open=true (pin S2). Raises SavepointStackOverflow if the stack is at SAVEPOINT_STACK_MAX_DEPTH (pin S7).

release_savepoint.doc: Find the innermost frame named `name`. Discard it AND every frame above it; their changes merge into the next-outer frame (or commit to the outer transaction if the released frame was outermost — pin S4). Raises SavepointNotFound if no matching frame exists. If the stack becomes empty and implicit_outer_open is true, commits the implicit outer transaction.

rollback_to_savepoint.doc: Find the innermost frame named `name`. Revert page state (via pager.revert_pages_to) and schema state (via pager.restore_schema) to that frame's marks. Discard frames ABOVE the matched frame; the matched frame ITSELF stays on the stack (pin S5b). Raises SavepointNotFound if no matching frame exists.

any_open.doc: Used by the pager's checkpoint scheduler to gate checkpoint while any savepoint frame is open (pin S8). Returns true iff `store.frames` is non-empty.
